source: 外研社(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 3 同主题完形(轮子与新能源车/四大发明/年轻发明家团队/电话的故事/居里夫人/质疑权威)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: The Wheel and the Car
passages.text: Most inventions begin when someone notices a (1)____ that needs solving. Long ago, moving heavy loads was very hard, so people invented the (2)____. Much later, this simple idea (3)____ into the car. Today cars are everywhere, but they also (4)____ pollution and use a lot of energy. For this (5)____, engineers have worked hard to build cleaner cars. New energy vehicles are now (6)____ by many companies around the world. They are (7)____ by electricity instead of petrol, so they are kinder to the (8)____. Some people think the great age of invention is (9)____, but they are wrong. As long as we keep (10)____ questions, new ideas will always appear.

questions.explanation: a problem that needs solving 待解决的问题。
invented the wheel 发明了轮子。
developed into the car 发展成汽车。
cause pollution 造成污染。
for this reason 因此。
are produced by companies 被公司生产。
powered by electricity 由电力驱动。
kinder to the environment 对环境更友好。
the age is over 时代结束了。
keep asking questions 不断提问。

passages.title: The Four Great Inventions
passages.text: Ancient China gave the world four great (1)____: gunpowder, papermaking, printing and the compass. Each of them (2)____ the world deeply. The compass, for (3)____, allowed sailors to find their way far from (4)____. Printing made books cheaper, so knowledge could be (5)____ more widely. These inventions were not made by a single (6)____, but by many people over time. Even today, the compass is still (7)____ in ships and planes. When we study the past, we (8)____ that invention has always been part of human (9)____. The desire to (10)____ is something all of us share.

questions.explanation: four great inventions 四大发明。
changed the world 改变了世界。
for instance 例如。
far from land 远离陆地。
could be shared 能被分享。
a single person 一个人。
is still used 仍被使用。
we learn that 我们懂得。
human history 人类历史。
the desire to create 创造的渴望。

passages.title: A Young Inventor
passages.text: My cousin Tom is only seventeen, but he is already a young (1)____. Last year he joined a small (2)____ of students who love science. Together they (3)____ a cheap robot that can help blind people cross the road. At first their robot did not (4)____ well, and many parts had to be (5)____ again and again. Tom almost wanted to give (6)____, but his teammates encouraged him to keep trying. Finally, after months of hard (7)____, the robot worked. Tom says that no great thing is ever done by one person (8)____. Most modern inventions are created by big (9)____ in which everyone shares ideas. He is proud to be (10)____ of such a group.

questions.explanation: a young inventor 年轻发明家。
a small team 一个小团队。
built a robot 制造了机器人。
did not work well 运转不好。
had to be changed 不得不更换。
give up 放弃。
hard effort 努力。
by one person alone 仅靠一人。
big teams 大团队。
be part of 成为……的一员。

passages.title: The Story of the Telephone
passages.text: The telephone is one of the most important (1)____ in history. It was (2)____ by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876. Bell was interested in sound because his mother and his wife were (3)____ to hear well. He wanted to build a machine that could (4)____ the human voice along a wire. After many (5)____, the first words were finally sent from one room to (6)____. Since that day, the telephone has been (7)____ by billions of people all over the world. It has completely (8)____ the way we live and work. Of course, the phones we use today look nothing like Bell's first (9)____. Yet the basic idea behind them is still the (10)____.

questions.explanation: important inventions 重要发明。
was invented by 由……发明。
unable to hear well 听不清。
carry the voice 传送声音。
after many tries 多次尝试后。
from one room to another 从一间到另一间。
has been used by 被使用。
has changed the way 改变了方式。
Bell's first model 贝尔最早的型号。
still the same 仍然相同。

passages.title: Marie Curie
passages.text: Marie Curie was one of the most (1)____ scientists in history. She was born in Poland but did most of her (2)____ in France. For years she worked in a cold, poor (3)____, studying a strange new material. Her research was so (4)____ that she was awarded the Nobel Prize, not once but (5)____. Sadly, the very material she studied slowly (6)____ her health. Even so, she never (7)____ to stop her work. Today her discoveries are still (8)____ by doctors to treat serious illnesses. Marie Curie showed that a (9)____ mind and a brave heart can change the world. Her story has (10)____ many young women to become scientists.

questions.explanation: the most famous scientists 最著名的科学家。
did her research 做研究。
a poor lab 简陋的实验室。
so significant that 如此重要。
not once but twice 不止一次,而是两次。
harmed her health 损害了她的健康。
never chose to stop 从未选择停下。
are still used 仍被使用。
a brilliant mind 才华横溢的头脑。
has inspired many 激励了许多人。

passages.title: Question Everything
passages.text: Good scientists never stop (1)____ questions, even about ideas that everyone (2)____. Take the famous story of the apple that (3)____ on Newton's head and led him to his theory of (4)____. For a long time, people simply (5)____ this story. Recently, however, more than one writer has (6)____ whether it is really true. They agree that Newton was (7)____ inspired by a falling apple, but there is no (8)____ that it hit him on the head. This does not make Newton less great. It only shows that, in science, every claim should be (9)____ by evidence. We should enjoy a good story, but we must not (10)____ everything we hear.

questions.explanation: stop asking questions 停止提问。
everyone accepts 人人接受。
the apple that fell 落下的苹果。
theory of gravity 万有引力理论。
simply believed 只是相信。
has questioned whether 质疑是否。
certainly inspired 的确受到启发。
no proof that 没有证据。
should be tested by evidence 应由证据检验。
must not believe everything 不可全信。
